About this collection

A local business directory.

This first edition features 50 businesses selected from the supplied company list across life sciences, satellite, defense, and technology.

Each listing has a documented Montgomery County, Maryland office or facility. A business may have headquarters or additional operations elsewhere. Public company and government sources were reviewed on October 26, 2026.

Company names link directly to their official websites. Descriptions are short summaries of their work. Logos belong to their respective owners.

This is an independent directory. Inclusion does not imply chamber membership, endorsement, or affiliation with Montgomery County government.
